metaDesc: Graphic design in Wolverhampton for social posts, flyers, brochures, ads and packaging. Source files included. Design packs from £99. DigiRanx Pro.

intro.h2: Graphic Design Wolverhampton Businesses Can Use Every Day
paras: DigiRanx Pro provides graphic design Wolverhampton businesses can use across every channel, from a single flyer to a full month of social media content. Our designers create on-brand graphics that look professional in print and online, so your posts, leaflets and adverts all feel like they come from the same company. We keep turnaround fast and small edits unlimited on our monthly plans, which makes it easy to keep your marketing moving.

Most small businesses do not need a full-time designer, but they do need good design regularly. A new offer needs a social post. An event needs a poster. A trade show needs a pull-up banner and a brochure. Our packages are built around that reality. You can order a one-off pack of five designs, or choose a monthly plan that gives you a steady supply of graphics without the cost of hiring in-house.

Everything we create is sized and prepared for where it will be used. Social graphics come in the right dimensions for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok. Print work is supplied as print-ready PDFs with correct bleed and colour settings. Ad creatives are built to the specifications of Google and Meta. You also receive the editable source files, so you own every design we make and can reuse it later.

We are a new design studio based at Dunstall Hill in Wolverhampton, working with businesses across Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley, Telford and the wider UK. Briefs can be sent by email or discussed on a quick call, and finished files arrive digitally. If you would rather not deal with printers yourself, we can arrange printing through our UK print partners and have the finished items delivered to your door.

why.h2: Why Choose DigiRanx Pro for Graphic Design
why.lead: You need graphics that look right, arrive on time and match your brand. Here is how we make that straightforward.

points.d: We build brand templates on our monthly plans, using your logo, colours and fonts. Every post, leaflet and advert then follows the same rules, so customers start to recognise your business at a glance wherever they see it.

Design packs are delivered within three working days. Monthly clients get a 48 hour turnaround, and Pro clients 24 hours. You can plan campaigns and promotions knowing exactly when the artwork will be ready to post or print.

Every project includes print-ready PDFs, PNGs and editable source files. There are no locked formats or extra charges to release your artwork, so you can reuse designs, make future changes or share them with other suppliers.

points.t: Print and Digital Under One Roof
points.d: We design for screens and paper with equal care. Social graphics, web banners, brochures, packaging and business cards can all come from one team, which keeps your brand consistent across everything customers see and hold.

benefits.lead: Well-made graphics do more than look attractive. They help customers understand you, trust you and act.

items.d: Clean, consistent design signals that a business is organised and reliable. Customers often judge quality from a leaflet or a social post before they ever speak to you, so strong visuals help you make a good first impression.
Posts, stories and covers designed for each platform stand out in busy feeds. Clear headlines and strong imagery stop the scroll and make your message easy to take in within a couple of seconds.
Static and animated banners designed for Google and Meta give your paid campaigns a better chance of getting clicks. Good ad creative makes every pound of your advertising budget go further.

Infographics turn processes, pricing or data into visuals people can follow quickly. They are useful on websites, in sales presentations and on social media, and they make your expertise easier to understand.

Flyers, brochures, labels and packaging are supplied with the correct bleed, resolution and colour settings. Your printer receives files that work first time, avoiding delays, reprints and unexpected costs.
Monthly plans give you a regular flow of graphics without hiring staff. Your marketing calendar stays full, and you avoid last-minute scrambles when a promotion, event or seasonal offer comes round.

steps.h2: How Our Graphic Design Service Works
steps.lead: Ordering design from us is simple. Here is what happens from the first brief to the final files.

items.d: Tell us what you need, where it will be used and any deadline. Send your logo, brand colours, photos and wording if you have them. If the brief is loose, we will ask a few questions to fill the gaps.
For new clients we gather your logo files, colours and fonts in one place. Monthly clients also receive brand templates, which speed up future requests and keep every design consistent.

Our designers create the first versions within your package turnaround time. You receive them as previews, sized correctly for each platform or print format, so you can see exactly how they will look.
You send feedback and we make the changes. Design packs include two revisions per design, while monthly plans include unlimited small edits, so tweaks to wording, dates or images are never a problem.
Once approved, you receive print-ready PDFs, PNGs and the editable source files. If you would like us to handle printing, we arrange it through our UK print partners and deliver to your door.

faqs.q: How Much Does Graphic Design Cost?
faqs.a: Our Pack is £99 one-off for five custom designs with two revisions each. The Monthly plan is £249 a month for 20 designs with unlimited small edits and a 48 hour turnaround. Pro is £499 a month for 50 designs, animated graphics and a dedicated designer. Prices are in GBP and exclude VAT.

faqs.q: Do I Get the Source Files?
faqs.a: Yes. You receive print-ready PDFs, PNGs and the editable source files for every design. You own the artwork we create for you, so you can reuse it, adapt it or pass it to another supplier in future without asking permission or paying extra to release it.

Yes. We can arrange printing through our UK print partners and have the finished items delivered to your door. That covers flyers, leaflets, brochures, business cards and more. It saves you dealing with print specifications yourself, and we check the artwork is set up correctly before it goes to press.

faqs.q: What Types of Graphics Do You Design?
faqs.a: We design social media posts, stories and covers, flyers, leaflets, brochures, business cards, static and animated ad banners, infographics, packaging and labels. If you need something not listed, ask us. Most marketing and print graphics fit within our packages, and we will tell you honestly if a request needs a different approach.

Design packs are delivered within three working days. On the Monthly plan, requests are turned around within 48 hours, and on the Pro plan within 24 hours. Larger pieces such as multi-page brochures may take longer, and we will agree a timeline with you before starting.

faqs.q: Do You Only Work With Local Businesses?
faqs.a: We are based in Wolverhampton and work with plenty of businesses across the West Midlands, including Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley and Telford. Because briefs and files are shared online, we also design for clients across the wider UK, with printed items delivered nationwide through our print partners.

cta.p: Send us your brief or tell us what you have coming up. Call +44 7445 652671 or email info@digiranxpro.com, Monday to Friday from 8am to 10pm, and we will recommend the right graphic design package for you.
